content.text: {"decision": "explain", "likely_cause": "Likely cause: every arrival on Customer (list) logs a console error and briefly shows a three-part overlay that is removed within about 15 to 30 ms, and users go back to Sales Invoice (new) about 2 s later, so the list page may not be giving them a usable result on arrival, though the events do not show what they did there.", "fix": "Fix: On the Customer (list) screen, resolve the console error logged on each load and stop the loading overlay from flashing, then check whether the Customer combobox on Sales Invoice (new) can open a customer picker in place instead of a full navigation to Customer (list).", "cited_event_ids": ["app:1", "app:2", "app:3", "app:4", "285", "304:w289", "310:x298", "284", "303:w288", "309:x297", "562", "581:w585", "587:x594", "609", "628:w600", "633:x608"], "confidence": "low", "unsupported": ["The reason users navigate to Customer (list) and return is not visible in the events.", "Whether the console error or overlay causes the return to Sales Invoice (new); the events show them co-occurring, not causing.", "Whether the Sales Invoice (new) draft is preserved or reset on return.", "Content shown on Customer (list) and any user actions there (no clicks or inputs recorded on that screen).", "Whether the overlay blocks interaction; it is shown and removed within tens of milliseconds."]}
